claims.text: The waiting-time fee of $5.00 is chargeable only where the trip was completed and the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded exceeded the free waiting period in force. The free waiting period for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the driver's own trace shows a continuous in-geofence dwell of only 100 seconds - a shortfall of 80 seconds. Under POL-NS-10(d) the waiting-time fee is not chargeable, and under POL-NS-10(e) the fare_breakdown waiting-time line must be refunded in full.

The effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force. The trace shows a single qualifying in-geofence run of 100 seconds (11 fixes, from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39), against a required minimum of 180 seconds for a STANDARD zone. The shortfall is 80 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the waiting fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The trip_record's own wait_timer_started event at 09:12:01 records a free waiting period of 180 seconds, and the trip was terminated at 09:43:59 - but the driver's GPS trace shows he left the pickup geofence at 09:13:39, only 100 seconds after the timer started. The platform's own telemetry and the GPS trace agree that the driver did not hold position for the required free waiting period. The waiting fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01 limb (c), which requires a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix.

The rider sent a message at 09:12:19 saying 'coming' - a coordinating message during the waiting window. The driver neither replied in the chat_log within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). The rider's own track places her device within the 100 m rider presence radius for STANDARD zone for the majority of qualifying fixes (241 rider fixes, all at 0.0 kph, mean distance 3.9 m from the pin). Under POL-NS-04 the rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

The driver's arrival marker was a BUTTON press at 09:11:59, and the GPS trace places him at that moment inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (min_distance_m 0.65 m, mean_distance_m 6831 m across the whole trip but the arrival fix is at the pin). The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 - the driver was stationary at the pin when he tapped. But the dwell that followed was only 100 seconds, so the fee fails on the dwell requirement, not on the arrival marker.

The fare_breakdown shows a waiting_time_fee of $5.00 charged on a completed trip, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The rider contests exactly this $5.00. Since the dwell did not exceed the free waiting period, the waiting-time line is refunded in full under POL-NS-10(e). The cancellation_fee line is 0.0, so no cancellation fee is in issue.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02740-01 is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable: the driver cannot rely on a kerb restriction or enforcement operation to sum separate in-geofence intervals. The single 100-second run stands as the whole dwell, and the shortfall is not excused.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0. Neither the POL-NS-09(c) repeat-dispute trigger nor the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger is engaged. The case is decidable on the evidence and does not require escalation.

claims.text: The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 09:11:59 and the platform started a free waiting period of 180 seconds at 09:12:01, but the trip was terminated by completion at 09:43:59 with no cancellation_reason_code and no rider no-show event anywhere in the record. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; the record shows cancellation_reason_code null and cancelled_by null, so limb (d) fails and the no-show fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

The rider's own message 'coming' was sent at 09:12:19 and read at 09:12:29, and the driver never replied in the chat log nor placed any in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). Under POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) the rider sent a coordinating message during the waiting window and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor called, so the rider is exonerated and the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The rider's device track places the rider within the STANDARD-zone rider presence radius of 100 m for the majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window: rider_presence shows 241 fixes with a maximum distance of 7.36 m from the pickup pin and a mean of 3.90 m, all at 0.0 kph. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is therefore affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes, completing the rider-exoneration test.

The driver's own trace shows a longest qualifying in-geofence run of only 100 seconds, from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39, against the STANDARD-zone minimum dwell of 180 seconds set by POL-NS-01(c) and the fee schedule. The shortfall is 80 seconds, so the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force and POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full whether or not the rider was present.

The waiting-time fee of $5.00 on the fare breakdown is not supported: POL-NS-10(d) makes a waiting-time fee chargeable only where the trip was completed and the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded exceeded free_wait_sec, and the measured dwell here is 100 seconds against a 180-second free waiting period. Under POL-NS-10(e) the unsupported waiting-time line is refunded in full.

The fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and a waiting_time_fee line of $5.00, so the contested amount is presently standing against the rider and a refund of that line is the remedy the policy provides. The charge is not a cancellation fee but a waiting-time fee, and POL-NS-10(e) is the clause that reaches it.

The driver's arrival marker is a BUTTON press, not a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, so POL-NS-12 does not apply and the arrival and dwell must be tested against the exported trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. The trace is complete at 100.0% coverage with 10-second sampling and no gaps, so the 100-second dwell reading is reliable and not an artifact of sparse data.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02740-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot be used to accumulate dwell across intervals: the limb requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and a MISSING advisory makes the limb unavailable. The 100-second dwell therefore stands as the effective dwell with no accumulation.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 0 and completed_trips_30d of 67, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and there is no basis to withhold compensation on that ground. But POL-NS-07 compensation is available only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) fails here, so no driver compensation is payable on this record.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so the POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) escalation triggers do not fire on this record. The case is decidable on the evidence and does not require human review.

ruling.explanation: Both of you: this dispute is about the $5.00 waiting-time fee on trip TRP-02740, and that fee cannot stand. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02740) shows a waiting_time_fee line of $5.00, a cancellation_fee line of $0.00 and a total_charged of $33.23, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the $5.00 is the contested amount, and it is the only charge in issue. / POL-NS-10(d) makes a waiting-time fee chargeable only where the trip was completed and the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded, measured as POL-NS-01(c) measures it, exceeded the free waiting period in force. The free waiting period for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (EV-TRIP-02740). The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02740), which is complete (100.0% coverage, 10-second sampling, no gaps), shows a single continuous in-geofence run from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39 - 100 seconds - because the driver left the geofence when the trip started at 09:13:39. The shortfall against the 180-second minimum is 80 seconds. The platform's own wait timer began at 09:12:01 (EV-TRIP-02740) but the driver did not hold position for the period the timer measured. POL-NS-10(e) therefore requires the unsupported waiting-time line to be refunded in full: $5.00 back to the rider. The independent POL-NS-06 shortfall argument and the POL-NS-01(c) dwell argument run to the same figure and are accepted. / Both advocates' points on the arrival marker are accepted: the marker is a driver BUTTON press, so POL-NS-12 does not apply and the exported trace governs (EV-TRIP-02740, EV-GPS-02740); and the tap was made with the driver at the pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 and no false-arrival referral is produced by that clause. / On the driver's side, no compensation is due. POL-NS-01 does not apply in full: limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated by the driver with a no-show reason code, but this trip was completed normally at 09:43:59 with cancellation_reason_code null and cancelled_by null (EV-TRIP-02740), and no cancellation fee was charged on the ledger. POL-NS-07 has nothing to pay out for that reason. The anti-farming check is nevertheless not tripped (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 0, completed_trips_30d 67), and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged (rider no_show_disputes_30d 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both profiles), so the case is decidable on the record. / The rider's POL-NS-04 arguments (the coordinating message 'coming' at 09:12:19, unanswered, with no in-app call, and the rider's device within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) point the same way, but the refund here flows from POL-NS-10(e). The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02740-01 is absent from the record; no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is required because only one interval exists, so the advisory does not affect the outcome in either direction. No clause produces a referral or an escalation on these facts. Confidence is 0.95, within the cap of 1.0 set by the artifacts that carry the deciding dwell fact (EV-GPS-02740 and EV-TRIP-02740, each at weight 1.0).

ruling.explanation:
The $5.00 waiting-time fee is refunded to you in full.

What the record shows. This was a completed trip, not a cancellation. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 09:11:59 (EV-TRIP-02740), the platform's free waiting period of 180 seconds began at 09:12:01, and the trip started at 09:13:39. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02740) records a single qualifying in-geofence run of 100 seconds, from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39 — a shortfall of 80 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s). The trip record's own wait_time_min of 1.7 minutes agrees with the trace.

Why the fee fails. POL-NS-10(d) makes a waiting-time fee chargeable only where the trip completed and the driver's in-geofence dwell, measured as POL-NS-01(c) measures it, exceeded the free waiting period. It did not: 100 s is short of 180 s. Under POL-NS-10(e) the unsupported waiting-time line is refunded in full. That line is fare_breakdown.waiting_time_fee = $5.00 (EV-FARE-02740), and it is the whole contested amount, so the refund is $5.00.

No cancellation or no-show fee is in issue: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 0.00, the trip completed with cancellation_reason_code null, and it was never terminated for a no-show, so POL-NS-01's four conditions (in particular limb (d)) are never reached. No driver compensation is payable — POL-NS-07 compensation attaches only where a verified no-show cancellation fee stands (80% of the fee in force), and there is none here.

Claims addressed. The rider's claims under POL-NS-10(d)-(e), POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-01(c) are accepted: they turn on the same 100-second dwell reading and yield the same full refund of the waiting-time fee. The rider's POL-NS-04 exoneration claims are also accepted and go further than needed — the 'coming' message at 09:12:19 was unanswered within 120 s with no in-app call, and the rider's track sits within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius across 241 fixes (mean 3.9 m) — so limb (c) is affirmatively satisfied rather than undecidable, and these points would independently refund the fee; they change neither the amount nor the outcome. The driver-side claims that the arrival marker is genuine (a BUTTON press made at the pin, not caught by POL-NS-05), that no driver compensation is due, and that no escalation follows, are accepted. As to the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02740-01: it is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and can carry no fact; it is not relied on, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is simply unavailable and irrelevant (there is only one in-geofence run anyway). The two claims built on it were discarded at Step 1 for not naming its issue code (MISSING_ARTIFACT), as POL-GEN-02(1) requires.

Escalation. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the artifacts agree on arrival and dwell rather than contradicting each other; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so neither the repeat-dispute nor the abuse limb is engaged; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 0); and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d).

Confidence and execution. The deciding fact — the 100-second dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-02740 and EV-TRIP-02740, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.95. The $5.00 refund is below the $8.00 POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the only amount in issue is the $5.00 waiting-time fee shown on the fare breakdown (waiting_time_fee $5.00, within total_charged $33.23, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00). The rider's claim that the driver waited less than the required time is correct, and the whole $5.00 is returned.

Why: under POL-NS-10(d) a waiting-time fee is chargeable only where the trip was completed AND the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded exceeded the free waiting period in force. This trip carries platform_policy.free_wait_sec of 180 seconds. The driver's own artefacts show a single continuous in-geofence run of 100 seconds, from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39 (11 fixes), against that 180-second minimum - a shortfall of 80 seconds. The trip record agrees (wait_time_min 1.7, and the platform's own wait_timer_started event at 09:12:01 records the 180-second free period). The GPS trace is complete: 100.0% coverage, 10-second sampling, no gaps, both tracks present, weight 1.0 - so the shortfall is a real measurement, not an artefact of sparse data. The waiting-time line is therefore unsupported and is refunded in full under POL-NS-10(e). That is the $5.00 the rider contested and the full amount is returned; the ruling is FULL_REFUND.

Points the parties raised that do not change the outcome: there is no cancellation fee on this trip (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee $0.00, status COMPLETED, cancellation_reason_code null), so POL-NS-01 limb (d) and the POL-NS-04 rider-exoneration route are not reached: the rider's 'coming' message of 09:12:19 went unanswered and the rider's device sat within about 7.4 m of the pin, but neither is needed to decide a fee that is not a cancellation fee. No driver compensation arises: POL-NS-07 pays a percentage of a chargeable cancellation fee and there is none, and in any event the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 0 of 67 completed trips in 30 days). The arrival marker is a BUTTON press, so POL-NS-12 does not apply and arrival and dwell are tested against the exported trace under POL-NS-02; the marker was not false (the driver was at the pin, within 50 m, when he tapped) and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artefacts agree rather than contradict, the repeat-dispute and abuse counters are zero, and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artefact. All figures are read from the brief's money block.

ruling.explanation:
This is a rider-filed dispute over a $5.00 waiting-time fee on trip TRP-02740, and both of you are addressed here. The trip was completed and no cancellation fee was charged (the fare breakdown EV-FARE-02740 shows cancellation_fee 0.00, waiting_time_fee 5.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), so the only money in issue is the $5.00 waiting-time line.

A waiting-time fee is chargeable only where the trip was completed and the driver's in-geofence dwell before the rider boarded exceeded the free waiting period in force - POL-NS-10(d). The free waiting period for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02740). The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02740) shows a single qualifying in-geofence run of 100 seconds, from 09:11:59 to 09:13:39, on 11 fixes, and the trip record agrees (wait_time_min 1.7, started_at 09:13:39). The dwell therefore fell 80 seconds short of the 180-second free waiting period. The $5.00 waiting-time line is not supported and is refunded in full under POL-NS-10(e). Both advocates' dwell-shortfall claims (POL-NS-10(d)/(e), POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-01(c)) are accepted: the measured dwell is 100 seconds against a required 180 seconds, an 80-second shortfall.

On the remaining points: POL-NS-05 - the driver's BUTTON arrival marker at 09:11:59 is not false, because the trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that moment, so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-04 is accepted and consistent with the outcome (the rider sent 'coming' at 09:12:19, the driver did not reply within 120 seconds and made no in-app call, and the rider's device stayed within 100 m on admissible fixes), though on a completed trip the operative clause for the fee is POL-NS-10. POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails (trip completed, cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null), which both sides accept; no no-show fee is in issue. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and the anti-farming check (no_show_terminations_30d 0 of 67 completed trips) is in any event not tripped. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, and the exported trace is in any case complete (100.0% coverage, 10-second cadence, no gaps), so the 100-second reading is reliable. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: no direct contradiction between artifacts, no repeat counterparty disputes, none of the abuse counters engaged, and the deciding fact rests on artifacts at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not approached. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02740-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact this ruling rests on; it is named here only for completeness.

In short: the rider's $5.00 waiting-time fee is refunded in full; the driver receives no compensation and no referral is issued. The monetary effect ($5.00) is below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this provisional ruling may be executed on issue, with the appeal route under POL-GEN-04 open to either party.
